newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates ease to 5.00-6.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates ease to 5.00-6.00 percent.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar eased to 5.00-6.00 percent on Monday from 6.00-6.50 percent on Sunday with maturing CDs helping dampen demand, dealers said.
They said over 13 million dinars of maturing CDs this week that reverted back to the banking system and were not all tied back in the new 15 million dinar CD auction helped liquidity.
Rates hovered around 7.75-8.50 percent at the end of weekly trade on Thursday in a week of tight liquidity.
